subject: Symphony expansion + renewal: multi-app slate, term options, and API key provisioning
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@symphony.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion + renewal: three new project teams, procurement timeline

Hi Monica,

Quick note to kick off planning: our Q3 initiative means we want to expand the current integration to three additional product teams (Search, Recommendations, and Support Bots). We expect peak aggregate consumption to grow from ~1M tokens/month to ~2.5M tokens/month across the org by October.

We also have an upcoming renewal in August and would like to combine the renewal with the expansion so procurement can sign a single MAA. Can you provide: 1) an outline of term/discount options for a combined renewal + expansion, 2) a staged key provisioning plan (we need separate API keys per project/team, ideally 11–13 keys to start), and 3) an estimated timeline to provision keys and apply rate/quotas?

Attaching a small usage snapshot and current topology. Procurement (procurement@symphony.co) is on copy; Sara Li will be managing the kickoff.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director of Integrations
Symphony Inc.

Attachment: Symphony_usage_detail_2028-07-10.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@symphony.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion + renewal: three new project teams, procurement timeline

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for including the procurement team. I’ve looped in Laura (Commercial) and Ben (Solutions) and priyom (RevOps) so we can provide a consolidated response and an activation plan.

High-level proposal (we can iterate on the call):
- Term options: 12 months (status quo) or 18 months with a 10% usage discount and prioritized provisioning windows; 24 months with a 15% discount if you want longer stability.
- Commit: recommend moving to a 2.5M token/month committed tier to cover expected growth; we can structure a seasonal burst allowance.
- Keys: we can provision 12 distinct API keys now, with staged activation (4 keys/week) and configurable per-key quotas and rate limits.
- Timeline: draft MAA and commercial sheet by 7/20; final sign-off and PO target 7/31; keys live (staged) between 8/1–8/15 depending on PO timing.

Next steps: can we do a 30-minute call Wednesday 7/13 to confirm the list of projects and the key cadence? If you prefer, we’ll send the MAA redline and a pricing table first.

I’ll attach a short rollout checklist and loop in Ben for technical constraints.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rollout_checklist_v1.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@symphony.co>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-12T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion + renewal: three new project teams, procurement timeline — provisioning notes

Alex / Monica — quick technical notes to set expectations for the staged rollout: 
- Keys & quotas: We’ll create 12 keys scoped to project tags (search, recs, support-bots, etc.) with per-key rate limits and monthly token caps. Please confirm the list of team names you want reflected in the key metadata.
- Burst capacity: If you expect bursty traffic, enable burst buckets (we can double rate limits for short windows) but that requires a higher reserved capacity bump or an on-demand fallback at a slightly higher unit price.
- KV/prefix caching: for Recommendations and Support Bots we recommend enabling prefix caching per key to reduce token usage and latency; we’ll provide config suggestions.
- Security: keys will be created with last-used rotation tags; rotation endpoint and automation examples included in API_Key_Specs.xlsx.

Attached is a provisioning template and the API spec for key attributes. We can support canary activation per environment (dev -> staging -> prod) and hold back two keys as hot spares.

If you confirm the team list by EOD Tuesday (7/14), we’ll queue provisioning to align with Monica’s timeline.

—Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: API_Key_Specs.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@symphony.co>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, procurement@symphony.co
Date: 2028-07-20T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion + renewal: three new project teams, procurement timeline — commercial terms

Alex / Sara / Procurement,

Thanks — based on the usage snapshot and the requested 12 keys, here’s a starter commercial proposal (numbers illustrative; formal quote attached):
- Commit: 2.5M tokens/month; overage priced at $0.0008/token.
- Term: 18 months recommended for this expansion with a 10% discount on usage line items.
- One-time provisioning fee: $1,500 (covers onboarding, keying, and canary activation support).
- Discount breakpoints: 10% @ 18 months, 15% @ 24 months, volume tier at 5M tokens/month for additional impact.

We’ve drafted a Master Access Agreement (MAA) and included the redline in Drive: Symphony_MAA_draft_2028-07-20.pdf. Procurement — to keep the provisioning schedule intact we need a signed MAA and PO by 2028-07-31. If procurement requires a separate SOW, we can provide one but it will add 3–5 business days to the timeline.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890/RDW-2028-SYM-0427
SOC2 evidence link (for your security team): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-symphony-expansion

Monica — once we have the PO we’ll issue keys per Ben’s provisioning template and schedule a technical kickoff.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Growth
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Symphony_MAA_draft_2028-07-20.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@symphony.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@symphony.co, ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, sara.li@symphony.co
Date: 2028-07-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion + renewal: three new project teams, procurement timeline — confirmed next steps

Thanks team — the commercial proposal looks good to Procurement. We’ll proceed with the 18-month term at the 2.5M token/month commit and the 10% discount. Procurement confirms they’ll route the PO to you this week; Sara will attach the internal approval schedule (attached).

Please provision the 12 keys with the following cadence: 4 keys on activation (dev), 4 keys on canary/stage, 4 keys on prod. Hold two keys as hot spares as Ben suggested.

Can we lock a technical kickoff for 2028-08-02 at 11:00 PT? If that works we’ll add the meeting invite.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Director of Integrations
Symphony Inc.

Attachment: Symphony_procurement_timeline_2028-07-21.pdf
